Main.sentence: South Jakarta ( ___E:Indonesian U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indonesian_language)___ : Jakarta Selatan ; ___E:Betawi U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Betawi_language)___ : Jakartè Beludik ) abbreviated as Jaksel , is one of the five ___E:administrative cities U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cities_of_Indonesia)___ ( kota administrasi ) which form the ___E:Special Capital Region of Jakarta U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jakarta)___ , ___E:Indonesia U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indonesia)___ .

South Jakarta is not ___E:self-governed U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Self-governance)___ and does not have a ___E:city council U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/City_council)___ , hence it is not classified as a proper ___E:municipality U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Municipality)___ .

It had a population of 2,062,232 at the 2010 Census;  the latest official estimate (for mid 2019) is 2,264,700,  and it is the third most populous among the five administrative cities of Jakarta, after ___E:East Jakarta U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/East_Jakarta)___ and ___E:West Jakarta U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/West_Jakarta)___ .
The administrative centre is at ___E:Kebayoran Baru U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kebayoran_Baru)___ .

South Jakarta is bounded by ___E:Central Jakarta U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Central_Jakarta)___ to the north, ___E:East Jakarta U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/East_Jakarta)___ to the east, ___E:Depok U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Depok)___ city to the south, ___E:West Jakarta U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/West_Jakarta)___ to the northwest, and by ___E:Tangerang U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tangerang)___ and ___E:South Tangerang U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Tangerang)___ cities to the west.

In the days following World War II, South Jakarta was planned to be a satellite city (especially the Kebayoran Baru area) and by using the oriental concept.
This area also contains some industrial centers for different types of commodities.
South Jakarta is a prosperous administrative city compared to the others, with much middle-to-upper class housing and major business centres.
South Jakarta has the highest Human Development Index of all Jakarta's administrative cities, with an HDI of 0.833.

Much of the ___E:central business district U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Central_business_district)___ is concentrated in Setiabudi, South Jakarta, such as ___E:Sudirman Central Business District U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sudirman_Central_Business_District)___ (SCBD) in ___E:Senayan, Kebayoran Baru U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Senayan,_Kebayoran_Baru)___ .
Initially, SCBD was a service provider and real estate investment, but nowadays, it is becoming the most integrated mixed-use area in Indonesia.
